Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

Waive Further Reading
Recommendation: After the City Attorney has read the title, waive full reading of ordinance considered on this agenda for introduction on first reading.
3.
Approval of a Letter to the U.S. Department of Transportation in Support of the Los Angeles Area Helicopter Noise Coalition Four Petitions for Reducing the Disturbance of Helicopters Flying Over the City
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the attached letter in support of the Los Angeles Area Helicopter Noise Coalition four petitions aimed at reducing the disturbance of helicopters flying over the City.
Staff Report
4.
Affirmation and Support of Mayor Letters Opposing SB 1069 (Wieckowski) Accessory Dwelling Units
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council affirm and support the letter from the Mayor in opposition to SB 1069 and authorize the transmittal of similar letters as needed.
Staff Report
5.
PW-627-15; Completion of Contract for the Citywide Drainage Improvements and Street Repair on Various Streets Project and Filing of Notice of Completion
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept as complete construction contract PW-627-15; completion of contract for the Citywide Drainage Improvements and Street Repair on Various Streets Project in the amount of $95,086.14; and direct the City clerk's office to file the Notice of Completion, and release the 5% retention 30 days after the County Recorder's office records the Notice of Completion, if no stop notices are filed.
Staff Report
6.
Expenditure of Citizen's Options for Public Safety (COPS) Funds and Adoption of Resolution R16-16 Authorizing the Expenditure to Complete the Police Department Firing Range Project
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R16-16, approving the use of FY14-15 COPS funds and approve the expenditure of an additional $4,140 to complete the Firing Range Project.
Staff Report
7.
Resolution R16-17; Affirming Planning Commission Approval of NC-1541/G-1559/M-1053/M-1066-15; Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading and Miscellaneous Applications for a New Single Family Residence Located at 2812 Victoria Place, with Additional Modifications. Lot 16, Block 2450, Tract 7332
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R16-17; affirming the Planning Commission's approval of NC-1541/G-1559/M-1053/M-1066-15; Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading, and Miscellaneous Applications for the new single family residence located at 2812 Victoria Place, with modifications. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

PC-433-16; Application to remove 3 Eucalyptus trees located in the Alondra Path adjacent to 4401 and 4309 Via Pinzon
Applicant: Bruce Herron
4305 Via Pinzon
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommended

If the tree is removed, it is required to be according to the 'Stand Conditions for Tree Removal approvals'. The applicant is required to pay $500 to the 'Tree Bank' and remove the stump. (4-1 in favor, Peterson dissenting)

WT-137-15; Wireless Telecommunication Facilities Application for new equipment within the City right-of-way across from 2325 Via Olivera.
Applicant: Crown Castle NG West LLC
300 Spectrum Center Dr., #1200
Irvine, CA 92618
Action: Approve the application (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The steel pole shall be burnished prior to painting. The pole and antennas must be painted a flat dark brown, and maintained in the same condition thereafter; 2) All cables interconnecting the antennas and all transmission equipment should run within the replacement pole except as minimally required to connect to the antennas; 3) The equipment cabinet should be painted a color to blend in with the existing surrounding environment and the adjacent steel pole in the public right-of-way; 4) The replacement steel pole is not a wireless tower for any purpose, but rather it is considered only a replacement school crossing and no parking sign pole, and that the new pole be owned by the City; 5) Permittee shall install and at all times maintain in good condition an â€œRF Noticeâ€ and â€œNetwork Operations Center Informationâ€ sign on the steel pole at approximately 11 feet above ground level on the pole; 6) Permittee shall ensure that all RF signage complies with FCC OET Bulletin 65 or ANSI C95.2 for color, symbol, and content conventions; 7) Attached signs shall be installed in accordance with the MUTCD (Manual Uniform Traffic Control Devices) California Edition; 8) Attached signs shall be with approved hardware per the Cityâ€™s Maintenance Foreman; 9) This authorization shall expire at 12:01 a.m. on the day following the tenth (10th) anniversary of the date the building permit for this site is issued. Unless this authorization is renewed prior to the expiration date, following whatever the applicable procedure is at that time, the wireless facility permitted herein shall be promptly removed at applicants sole cost and expense, and any damage to the land, pole and/or CISH shall be promptly repaired by applicant; 10) The applicant shall work with City Staff to provide appropriate landscaping to screen the proposed cabinet and related equipment; 11) Staff shall work with the Art Jury to determine the appropriate color for the proposed pole and cabinet; and 12) The applicant shall work with City Staff to determine the appropriate location of the proposed cabinet.

e.
WT-137-15; Wireless Telecommunication Facilities Application for new equipment within the City right-of-way across from 2325 Via Olivera.
Applicant: Crown Castle NG West LLC
300 Spectrum Center Dr., #1200
Irvine, CA 92618
Action: Approve the application (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The steel pole shall be burnished prior to painting. The pole and antennas must be painted a flat dark brown, and maintained in the same condition thereafter; 2) All cables interconnecting the antennas and all transmission equipment should run within the replacement pole except as minimally required to connect to the antennas; 3) The equipment cabinet should be painted a color to blend in with the existing surrounding environment and the adjacent steel pole in the public right-of-way; 4) The replacement steel pole is not a wireless tower for any purpose, but rather it is considered only a replacement school crossing and no parking sign pole, and that the new pole be owned by the City; 5) Permittee shall install and at all times maintain in good condition an "RF Notice" and "Network Operations Center Information" sign on the steel pole at approximately 11 feet above ground level on the pole; 6) Permittee shall ensure that all RF signage complies with FCC OET Bulletin 65 or ANSI C95.2 for color, symbol, and content conventions; 7) Attached signs shall be installed in accordance with the MUTCD (Manual Uniform Traffic Control Devices) California Edition; 8) Attached signs shall be with approved hardware per the City's Maintenance Foreman; 9) This authorization shall expire at 12:01 a.m. on the day following the tenth (10th) anniversary of the date the building permit for this site is issued.
